rule: The model selects a host snapshot key and which sections to show. Every value shown comes from the host document (tools/openui-intent-doc.mjs); the model never supplies data, labels or actions.

IntentBoard.description: Root. Select one host-provided intent snapshot key and 1 to 8 distinct sections, in display order. Never invent snapshot keys or data.

DeclaredIntent.description: The exact asked words, split into the task and its context, with the immutable source hash.

ContractGates.description: Approval state, observed preconditions and acceptance clauses of the pending intent contract.

WorkSlices.description: The contract's implementation slices and their observed state. Implementation is not acceptance.

ProofReceipts.description: Whether the real-turn acceptance receipt exists, and the preconditions observed for it.

DecisionMix.description: z0intelligence decision events broken down by one host-computed dimension.

TokenValue.description: Estimated vs measured vs verified token value, kept apart.

ContextFlow.description: Next-context prediction episodes and family top-1 on labeled rows.
